title: Hosted API Enterprise Request Onboarding and Ranking Framework for Chat, Streaming, and Tool Calls
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a repeatable onboarding and ranking framework for enterprise feature requests targeting the Hosted API (chat, streaming, tool/function calling, structured outputs). The goal is to reduce decision latency, surface regulatory/security signals early, and provide deterministic routing to self-serve, product, or enterprise engagement tracks. This outlines form fields, automated scoring, SLA bands, routing rules, escalation flows, and runbook updates required for the Console intake surface and solutions engineering intake.
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical intake form in Confluence + linkable canonical URL used by Solutions/AE/Support for enterprise Hosted API feature requests
Automated scoring pipeline that assigns a numeric priority (0-100) and SLA band (Bronze/Silver/Gold) based on the rubric described below
Routing rules implemented in the intake sheet / Zapier / intake tool that deliver requests to the correct queue (self-serve backlog, PM backlog, enterprise intake queue) with a traceable ticket
Escalation matrix documented and verified with engineering and security for high-risk requests
A short list of 6 example requests (chat streaming, tool calls, structured outputs) routed through the framework and outcomes recorded
steps: Draft canonical intake form fields and publish to Confluence
Define scoring rubric weights and thresholds (Business Impact, Security/Compliance, Technical Complexity, Latency Sensitivity, Customer Readiness)
Implement a spreadsheet prototype with formulas and Zapier webhook to create Linear tickets
Align routing rules with Solutions Engineering, Sales, Security, and Eng triage leads
Pilot with 5 incoming enterprise requests over two weeks and collect feedback
Finalize runbook and update the Console support docs and Solutions playbook
scoring_rubric: Business Impact (weight 35%): ARR influence, number of seats/users affected, strategic logos
Security/Compliance Risk (weight 25%): data residency, regulated data types, encryption/KMS needs
Engineering Effort (weight 20%): rough T-shirt estimate converted to points
Latency/Availability Sensitivity (weight 10%): SLO tightness or hard real-time constraints
Product Readiness & Customer Willingness to Pilot (weight 10%): committed POC or signed MSA
score_thresholds: Gold (>=80): Engage enterprise onboarding, assign solutions + dedicated PM + prioritized eng lane (SLA: response 2 business days)
Silver (50-79): Product backlog review and potential scoped sprint work (SLA: response 5 business days)
Bronze (<50): Self-serve guidance, docs, and templated workarounds; can be escalated if sponsor or revenue changes (SLA: response 10 business days)
routing_rules: If Security/Compliance score >= 70 then route to Security review queue before PM prioritization
If Business Impact >= 60 AND Engineering Effort <= 30 then route to Fast-track PM lane
If customer is Enterprise tier AND requests data residency or VPC then route to Private deployment sales + Eng
If request is purely SDK/contract change with no infra work then route to Developer Experience backlog
escalation_matrix: Level 1 (PM triage): initial scoring and routing (Owner: PM Ops)
Level 2 (Eng + Security): for scores with Security/Compliance >=70 or estimated effort >=50 points (Owners: Eng Lead, Security Lead)
Level 3 (Executive): for strategic logos, >$500k ARR impact, or cross-region legal blocks (Owner: Head of Product + Head of Sales)
Timebox: automatic escalation to Level 2 if no action in 5 business days for Gold requests
